# `sheetConfigs`: the sheet list

Part of [generated data](../generated-data.md). `hasIdColumn`, `hasNameColumn` and `idPrefix` are sampled from the described sheet; Let api access is declared on Sheet Config.

## How `sheetConfigs` is generated

**`sheetConfigs`** (`generated/sheetConfigs.ts`) — generated by `SheetConfigOperator` (`05_Operators`), reading the real "Sheet Config" sheet by name. **`hasIdColumn` is *sampled*** at emit time from whether the described sheet's header row contains the configured ID header, not from a Sheet Config checkbox. **`hasNameColumn` is sampled** the same way, from the configured Name header; a sheet with both is one `SheetNamed.rowIdByName` can search. **`idPrefix` is *sampled*** from the described sheet's column ID row, assigned from the tab title when that row has no column IDs yet, and checked against the previous generated entry for the same sheet GID — a difference is reported, not failed. Let api access stays a human declaration on Sheet Config except on a **self-describing row**, where the correction pass writes the floor seed. ID prefixes must be unique across those entries. The generated constructor and Sheet Config emit share that check.
